title: Suppress completed items from subsequent routine progress reports
summary: After the 100 percent completion of a project, phase, milestone, task or feature has been reported once, omit it from later routine progress reports while preserving the underlying roadmap and completion history.
statement: After the 100 percent completion of a project, phase, milestone, task or feature has been reported once, omit it from later routine progress reports while preserving the underlying roadmap and completion history.
rationale: Public-safe, scoped project-development requirement normalized from an independently authorized specimen.

conditions: An item's 100 percent completion was already announced in an earlier report.
exceptions: This does not erase archived completion data; explicitly reopened work may be reported as incomplete.
